items.check: **No workarounds**: No TODOs, FIXMEs, stubs, or partially-implemented features
items.evidence: The authoritative particle graph determines order; no choice_index mirror or fixture-name branch is added. Required empty records reach normal validation. Independent whitespace schema defects are recorded below for the immediately following increment, as allowed by the execution prompt.

items.check: **Exception safety**: C++ uses `ReferenceHolder` for Qore allocations, `std::unique_ptr` for C++ allocations, `*xsink` checked after every fallible operation
items.evidence: Source conversion owns its fresh parse result until successful return; namespace maps remain local copy-on-write values. Decode builds a local hash and publishes no partial result on conversion failure. Existing cancellation/reconstruction tests pass in all execution modes.

items.check: **Thread safety**: All mutable shared state protected by `std::lock_guard<std::mutex>` or documented as immutable-after-construction
items.evidence: Changes add no shared mutable state. Source normalization precedes schema publication; decode only reads completed declarations and uses local maps.

items.check: **Type safety**: Strongly-typed `code<return(args)>` instead of untyped `code`; `static_cast` instead of C casts; typed hashdecls for results; enums where appropriate
items.evidence: Reference<auto> preserves the XML sum-type contract; namespace, identity, field-presence and occurrence maps remain typed. New test helpers have concrete parameter and return types.

items.check: **Performance**: No O(n²) where O(n) is possible; no unnecessary copies; coordinate descent uses incremental residuals not full matrix multiply
items.evidence: Normalization rebuilds only non-compositor hashes that require suffix merging; no regex key helper or per-child full declaration scan is added. Field projection is linear in declarations and supplied fields. Paired Release normalization measurements retain their exact inputs and environment.

items.check: **Error handling**: All inputs validated (dimensions, empty data, unfitted models); C++ I/O handles EAGAIN/EINTR if applicable
items.evidence: Tests enforce missing/duplicate choices, unknown fields, invalid empty XML, restricted choices, required attributes and namespace-aware imports. An explicit empty flat record no longer disappears before required-particle validation.

items.check: **Documentation**: Doxygen `@param`, `@return`, `@throw` on all public methods; `@par Example` with realistic business scenarios; `@note` for important caveats
items.evidence: Release notes and durable particle design describe final behavior and compatibility. The nested ENUM provisioning example executes in the new test. qdx and Doxygen complete without warnings; there is no new public production API.

items.check: **QPP flags**: `[flags=CONSTANT]` on methods that never throw; `[flags=RET_VALUE_ONLY]` on methods that throw but have no side effects
items.evidence: No QPP methods or flags change.

items.check: **Security**: No user-controlled format strings; no buffer overflows; bounds checking on array indices; no credentials in code
items.evidence: Format strings are fixed; fixture data contains no credentials. Names originate in parsed XML, and string position results are checked before slicing. Snapshot exceptions preserve error categories and cancellation.

items.check: **Correctness**: Algorithms verified against reference implementations; edge cases tested (empty data, single sample, all-zero features)
items.evidence: The original 34-assertion regression passes with equivalent particle diagnostics and the existing attribute metadata field. The new suite passes 284 assertions, including both bindings/directions, standalone/imported schemas and reconstruction. All 128 suites and 13 supplements pass; the 1000-model oracle has 15132 rows. Corpus outcomes are unchanged.
